dedupe_keys.name: ih set shoreline evolution tools ihcantabria

description: IH-SET (Shoreline Evolution Tools) is an open, modular software of IHCantabria for simulating and analysing shoreline evolution at different spatial and temporal scales, released publicly in March 2026 under the Thinking Azul marine science plan funded by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities and the Government of Cantabria. It integrates several morphodynamic modelling approaches in one environment with three modules: preprocessing, which harmonises wave, sea level and shoreline observation inputs and builds the numerical domain; models, which covers static equilibrium, equilibrium-trending shoreline models, one-line models and hybrid approaches with calibration and evaluation tools; and visualisation, which compares results and scenarios and produces metrics. It can evaluate coastal change scenarios with sea level rise, sediment dynamics and human interventions, from single beaches to larger coastal systems, and the team reports validating it in different coastal settings. The software website and technical documentation are available online, and the tool is described as open software already available to the scientific community, administrations and practitioners; no licence name or price is given in the news item read. Caveats: this is a first version, and results depend on local calibration data. Coverage is general, developed on Spanish coasts. It supports climate adaptation and hazard exposure analysis of coastal erosion threatening seafront roads, ports and defences; related records are the IHData wave hindcasts and the CEREMA coastal erosion indicator.
